versions.changelog: 同步 GitHub 最新版本
版本对齐 2.2.0，补 slug/license 字段

hectorlee-daily-precision-picker v0.1.1

- Skill doc now versioned as V2.3 with full changelog and includes explicit "离线容错" (offline fallback) in the strategy description.
- Added .gitignore and _user_meta.json files for project organization.
- Updated SKILL.md with clarified workflow, scores, edge-case handling, and detailed real-world usage notes.
- manifest.yaml and scripts/precision_picker.py updated accordingly to align with new documentation structure and versioning.
- No breaking changes; overall structure and major algorithms remain consistent.

- Initial release of "hectorlee-daily-precision-picker" skill (v0.1.0)
- Implements a 4-layer funnel strategy for daily stock selection with 3-tiered output (精选, 优选, 关注池)
- Optimized structure based on extensive backtesting: only MA support is a hard condition; volume-price quality is downweighted, capital flow takes leading role (75% score weight)
- Both closing and intraday operation modes supported, including robust deduplication logic for historical signals
- Clearly defined filtering criteria for fundamental safety, capital inflow scoring, and sector/technical pattern scoring
- Automated structured report output: tiered lists, sector heatmap, and actionable suggestions
